name: Stop Time
description:
You cause time to stop for everyone except you. Roll Lore. The result, divided by 5, is the number of turns you may take before time resumes for everyone else. While taking these turns, you may spend actions and move as normal.

If you touch or target a creature or object worn or carried by another creature with an attack or ability, the effect immediately ends and time resumes its course.

Describe how you stop time.
successes:
✨: The effect lasts for one additional turn.

🌞: You may instead stop time for up to 1 minute.

💀: Time stops only for you for 1 turn.
